// diagnostic E0373

Jet.ExplicitSemicolon

A `;` can't stand here: it only separates statements and items

What

A `;` can't stand here: it only separates statements and items

Why

A `;` means a line break between statements or items; inside a member list, an argument list, a type, a loop header or an interpolation hole it separates nothing.

Fix

Write `,` between members or arguments, or remove the `;`.
